ipsius ac negotij, cuius gratia commenda-

page.notes: Greek words in the first line, in "Pars tertia", "partim" and "Vel" are not legible enough to copy and are marked illegible. A faint mark at the bottom left ("nr.3") is a scan or stray mark, not printed text, and is left out. The signature is read as "a 3".
